settings.legalParams.valueInvalid: The value must be a number, text or valid JSON.

settings.card.complianceDesc: Food traceability, İTS / ÜTS product classes and the adjustment approval threshold.
settings.complianceModules.title: Compliance modules
settings.complianceModules.subtitle: Regulated product groups your company trades in. Enabled modules can be chosen as a product category and are checked against their rules.
settings.complianceModules.desc.food: Lot and expiry tracking; recall and traceability (enforced with WP6).
settings.complianceModules.desc.medicine: Data matrix data: GTIN + serial + lot + expiry. İTS notifications are out of scope.
settings.complianceModules.desc.medical_: UDI-DI (GTIN) and lot or serial number. ÜTS notifications are out of scope.
settings.complianceModules.desc.cosmetic: Batch number tracking. ÜTS cosmetic notifications are out of scope.
settings.complianceModules.outOfScope: Live İTS / ÜTS notifications are not part of this release; only the data they require is kept.
settings.approval.title: Second approval for stock adjustments
settings.approval.subtitle: Manual adjustments whose estimated value (difference × unit price) exceeds this threshold are booked only after an administrator other than the requester approves them.
settings.stockLock.title: Stock lock date
settings.stockLock.subtitle: No stock movement (back-dated purchase, sale, adjustment, reversal) can be dated on or before this date. Protects closed periods and delivered counts.
settings.stockLock.hint: Even without a lock, movements cannot be dated before 1 January of the previous year; back-dated exits are checked against the stock on their date.
settings.controlChange.hint: Moving the stock lock date back or loosening the approval threshold needs a second administrator. The change is not applied until it is approved.
settings.controlChange.pending: Other settings were saved. The stock control change was sent to a second administrator (Stock movements > Pending approvals).
settings.taxRates.trSubtitle: In Türkiye VAT rates come from the legal catalog and cannot be edited (invalid rates such as 18 % are refused). 0 % is the Exemption row and needs an exemption code. Only the default rate can be chosen.
settings.taxRates.importerOrOre: The company imports iron-steel / produces it from ore
settings.taxRates.importerOrOreHint: When set, the 627 iron-steel withholding is not applied to sales (KDVGUT I/C-2.1.3.3.8).
settings.exchangeRates.tcmbHint: VAT conversion uses the TCMB forex buying rate of the tax point; cross rates are never used.
settings.taxRates.designatedBuyer: The company is a designated buyer (public administration etc.)
settings.taxRates.designatedBuyerHint: When set, withholding codes limited to designated buyers also apply to purchases (KDVGUT I/C-2.1.2.1).
settings.card.inventoryAccountingDesc: Period closing, costing method, account mappings, wastage and destruction rates
settings.periods.title: Fiscal periods
settings.periods.hint: A closed period takes no stock movement (VUK 174). Stock lock date: {lock}. Reopening needs a reason and a second administrator's approval.
settings.periods.closeConfirm: Period {period} will be closed: the closing balance is recorded and no movement can be dated in it. Continue?
settings.periods.reopenHint: The request goes to a second administrator (Stock movements > Pending approvals).
settings.periods.reopenSent: The reopen request was sent for approval.
settings.costing.title: Costing method
settings.costing.changed: Costing method saved (the reason is in the audit log).
settings.costing.hint: Following the consistency principle the method changes only from the start of an open fiscal year (TTK 66/4). LIFO is not available.
settings.mappings.title: Account mappings (journal export)
settings.mappings.hint: Uniform Chart of Accounts defaults apply; a company mapping replaces the default. {STOCK} is the stock class account (150-157), {COGS} the cost of sales account.
settings.mappings.notBilanco: The journal export is only available on the balance-sheet basis.
settings.wastage.title: Normal wastage rates
settings.wastage.hint: The category rate applies to products without their own rate. Wastage above it is abnormal and enters the VAT correction. A source is required.
settings.policies.title: Stock policies
settings.policies.destructionHint: The rate is assigned to the company by the Ministry; destruction above it goes to the valuation commission.
settings.policies.bestBeforeHint: Goods past their use-by date can never be sold. Allowing sales after best-before is a company policy; switching it on needs a second administrator and is audited.
